lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham jap sadaa nihaal || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar thaan thana(n)tar jat kat pekhau soee ||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, in all places and interspaces, wherever I look, He is there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur paaio vadabhaagee tis jevad avar na koee ||2||11||39||
lines.translation: Nanak has found the Guru, by great good fortune; no one else is as great as He. ||2||11||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan sahaj dhun prabh ke charan nihaariaa ||
lines.translation: I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current, gazing upon the feet of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhio baarik satigur taap utaariaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Savior has saved His child, and the True Guru has cured his fever. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ubare satigur kee saranaaee ||
lines.translation: I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sev na birathee jaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar mahi sookh baahar phun sookhaa prabh apune bhae daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well, when God becomes kind and compassionate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bighan na laagai kooo meraa prabh hoaa kirapaalaa ||2||12||40||
lines.translation: O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful to me. ||2||12||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g bhaiaa man udam naam ratan jas gaaee ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my mind became excited, and I sang the Praises of the jewel of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mit gaee chi(n)taa simar ana(n)taa saagar tariaa bhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: My anxiety was dispelled, meditating in remembrance on the Infinite Lord; I have crossed over the world ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai har ke charan vasaaee ||
lines.translation: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh paaiaa sahaj dhun upajee rogaa ghaan mitaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have found peace, and the celestial sound current resounds within me; countless diseases have been eradicated. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa keemat kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I speak and describe? Your worth cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat bhae abinaasee apunaa prabh bhaiaa sahaaee ||2||13||41||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees become imperishable and immortal; their God becomes their friend and support. ||2||13||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gae kales rog sabh naase prabh apunai kirapaa dhaaree ||
lines.translation: My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar aaraadhahu suaamee pooran ghaal hamaaree ||1||
lines.translation: God has showered me with His Grace. Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore my Lord and Master; my efforts have come to fruition. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu too sukh sa(n)pat raas ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh laihu bhaaee mere kau prabh aagai aradaas || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਖਸਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo maagau soee soee paavau apane khasam bharosaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhetio mitio sagal a(n)desaa ||2||14||42||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled. ||2||14||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar gur satigur apanaa sagalaa dookh mitaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Guru, the True Guru, all pains have been eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taap rog gae gur bachanee man ichhe phal paaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The fever and the disease are gone, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa gur pooraa sukhadaataa ||
lines.translation: My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee pooran purakh bidhaataa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ana(n)d binod ma(n)gal gun gaavahu gur naanak bhae daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in bliss, joy and ecstasy; Guru Nanak has become kind and compassionate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar bhae jag bheetar hoaa paarabraham rakhavaalaa ||2||15||43||
lines.translation: Shouts of cheers and congratulations ring out all over the world; the Supreme Lord God has become my Savior and Protector. ||2||15||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣੀਆ ਕਾਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaree ganat na ganeeaa kaaee apanaa birad pachhaan ||
lines.translation: He did not take my accounts into account; such is His forgiving nature.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haath dei raakhe kar apune sadaa sadaa ra(n)g maan ||1||
lines.translation: He gave me His hand, and saved me and made me His own; forever and ever, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib sad miharavaan ||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master is forever merciful and forgiving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dh paaiaa merai satigur poorai hoee sarab kaliaan || rahaau ||
lines.translation: My Perfect Guru has bound me to Him, and now, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu paai pi(n)d jin saajiaa ditaa painan khaan ||
lines.translation: The One who fashioned the body and placed the soul within, who gives you clothing and nourishment

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: apane daas kee aap paij raakhee naanak sad kurabaan ||2||16||44||
lines.translation: - He Himself preserves the honor of His slaves. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||44||
